componentLosses.accountingRule: one source fold relation loss per accepted product layer
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: concrete Swift extractor schedule and source fold transcript-loss instantiation for accepted proof-envelope bytes

componentLosses.accountingRule: one terminal seal relation loss per accepted NumiSeal terminal proof envelope
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: terminal aggregation, residual opening, and component-root reduction loss instantiated for the selected depth

componentLosses.accountingRule: zero recursive carry hops at selected depth 1; recursive child promotion requires one typed carry producer/consumer loss per hop
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: selected-depth typed-required carry vector, hosted replay semantics, and parent-child-to-chain induction

componentLosses.accountingRule: one simulator distinguishing loss per accepted masked residual product proof
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: full simulator coupling for repeated product proofs under the declared leakage model

componentLosses.accountingRule: one QROM Fiat-Shamir transform loss per accepted product transcript plus transcript collision loss
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: public-coin interactive protocol, transform preconditions, quantum random-oracle query bound, and collision/malleability proof

componentLosses.accountingRule: one concrete extractor failure term per accepted product layer and recursive transcript schedule
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: extractor implementation evidence over product proof bytes, source fold bytes, terminal seal bytes, and recursive carry context bytes

componentLosses.accountingRule: local replay identity is pinned; hosted tenant replay and revocation distribution must instantiate operational freshness loss before production
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: durable hosted context storage, tenant authorization, key rotation, audit retention/export, and revocation feed distribution

componentLosses.accountingRule: no product privacy promotion until CPU, Swift, LLVM, allocator, Metal, GPU timing, and failure-path evidence close
release distribution is outside the proof until signed artifacts, provenance, notarization, and branch-protection evidence are pinned
componentLosses.requiredEvidence: release signing key, signed release provenance, notarization/publication path, branch protections, and archived release evidence

totalLossRule.selectedDepthExpression: epsilon_total(depth=1) = epsilon_fold + epsilon_terminal + epsilon_zk_sim + epsilon_qrom + epsilon_extract + epsilon_collision + epsilon_replay + epsilon_ct + epsilon_release
totalLossRule.recursivePromotionExpression: epsilon_total(depth=d) = d * (epsilon_fold + epsilon_terminal + epsilon_zk_sim + epsilon_qrom + epsilon_extract) + max(d - 1, 0) * epsilon_carry + epsilon_collision + epsilon_replay + epsilon_ct + epsilon_release

hardClaimBlockers: hosted product operations replay and revocation freshness
